prediction_points.checkout: after checkout and payment submission, before approval or dispatch
prediction_points.handover: when the carrier records receiving the parcel from the seller

population: delivered orders with a carrier handover after purchase and before delivery
reason: ridge_100 has the lowest mean validation MAE (5.0985); linear_baseline (5.1462) is within 0.05 days and simpler, so it is chosen
rule: lowest mean validation MAE over 5 chronological windows; candidates within 0.05 days of the lowest lose to the simplest; baselines and the ensemble are reference only
test_status: post hoc: the later period was opened before the handover stage was designed
